lines.text: Each army division had 24,000 men and served the king for one month of the year.
Benaiah son of Jehoiada the priest commanded the division for the third month and was over the Thirty.
Over the tribes, Zadok was over Aaron, and Elihu, one of David's sons, was over Judah.
David did not count men aged twenty or under, and because of the census, peace came upon Israel.
Obil the Ishmaelite was in charge of the camels, and Hushai the Archite was the king's friend.
